Ready for the maintainer to merge.

Earlier review findings (`6f0e8eaeb7c1ad8a1fe20e29be60741e98ff44c1`):

1. `crates/ui/src/egui_app/predrilled_page_tests.rs:34` and `:164` (fixture fields): fixed in `9dd166f05df1c4cebfd1255c43bda69ecfb2c50c`. The Pocket fixture now sets `corner_relief: Default::default()` and `pass_start: Default::default()`. The rest fixture now sets `source: RestSource::EnteredTool`. All three tests in `egui_app::predrilled_page_tests` compile and pass.
2. `crates/ui/src/egui_app/predrilled_page.rs:24` / PR body (before/after screenshots): fixed. The PR body links `pocket-lead-before.png` and `pocket-lead-after.png` on the fork's `pr-screenshots` branch at `03edacff2d61c113551f31c9e40168f044e578c3`. The PR branch contains no image files.

What looks good:

- `predrilled_group` uses the `group` and `consequence` form helpers in `crates/ui/src/egui_app/predrilled_page.rs`.
- The header switch edits only the draft. Apply commits `links.approach.predrilled` through `EditOperationParams`, and undo and redo restore the value.
- The open group shows `REST_PREDRILLED` when rest machining is active in the draft.
- The other operation kinds do not show the group.
- New modules include provenance lines, `docs/decisions/1449-predrilled-entry-group.md` records the decision, and the PR body includes `Changelog:` and `Refs #1449`.

Results merged with main (locally):

- PR head: `9dd166f05df1c4cebfd1255c43bda69ecfb2c50c`.
- Base: `upstream/main` at `74ea8988d800f00d41547ec9d292077d2bc3ddc5`.
- Trial merge: `9f6578e4aaac3368aa5c65ee946e5b89bf3f1909`. The merge is clean, and `HEAD^1` is the PR head.
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: 10 steps passed, 0 failed.
  - `ui build (--no-run)`: passed (129s).
  - `ui suites: lib`: 1479 passed, 0 failed, 8 ignored (98s). All three `egui_app::predrilled_page_tests` tests passed.
  - `ui` integration suites: `boundary` (3), `boundary_picks` (7), `contour_dxf_sketch` (2), `sinker_setup` (2), `tap_hand` (3), `theme_example` (3), `theme_files` (17), and `waterjet_tool` (1). Total: 38 passed, 0 failed.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed (31s).
- `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main --dry-run`: 0 steps. The diff reaches no heavy lane.

Extra suites run: none beyond the quick plan. The diff changes no test data, fixture directories, importers, posts, operations, motion code, or catalog.

Mutations: not run. This PR changes only UI code and a decision file. It does not change posted G-code, gouge checks, collision checks, stock simulation, or geometry. No goldens moved. No pixel snapshots changed or ran.

Requested before merge: none.

Optional, non-blocking:

- `crates/ui/src/egui_app/mill2d_page.rs` is now 416 lines (415 lines on `upstream/main` before this one-line addition).

The verdict is `merge-ready`. The worktree `.claude/worktrees/review-2817` and the `review-2817` branch remain in place.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
